name: DuffinSchaeffer.MertensAux.sum_log_div_Icc

name: DuffinSchaeffer.MertensAux.sum_primes_Ioc_succ

      ∑ p ∈ (Ioc M n).filter Nat.Prime, f p + if (n + 1).Prime then f (n + 1) else 0

name: DuffinSchaeffer.MertensAux.sum_primes_succ

lemma sum_primes_succ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) :

      ∑ p ∈ (Iic n).filter Nat.Prime, f p + if (n + 1).Prime then f (n + 1) else 0

name: DuffinSchaeffer.sum_prod_one_add_le

lemma sum_prod_one_add_le (N : ℕ) (T : ℝ) (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hg : ∀ p, 0 ≤ g p) :

      (N : ℝ) * ∏ p ∈ (Icc 1 N).filter (fun p : ℕ => p.Prime ∧ T ≤ (p : ℝ)),
        (1 + g p / p)

      ∏ p ∈ ((Iic N).filter Nat.Prime).filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ m),

name: DuffinSchaeffer.CoprimeSieveAux.sum_F_logN_le

lemma sum_F_logN_le (m N : ℕ) :

name: DuffinSchaeffer.CoprimeSieveAux.sum_F_log_le

statement:
theorem alt_esum_split_fst (G : GCDGraph) (v : ℕ) :
    esum G.μ G.E = esum G.μ (G.E.filter (fun e => e.1 ≠ v)) + G.μ v * wsum G.μ (G.nbhdV v)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.alt_esum_split_snd
statement:
theorem alt_esum_split_snd (G : GCDGraph) (w : ℕ) :

statement:
theorem alt_induce_isSubgraph (G : GCDGraph) (V' W' : Finset ℕ) (E' : Finset (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hV : V' ⊆ G.V) (hW : W' ⊆ G.W) (hE : E' ⊆ G.E) (hE' : E' ⊆ V' ×ˢ W') :
    (G.induce V' W' E' hV hW hE hE').IsSubgraph G

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.alt_induce_quality
statement:
theorem alt_induce_quality (G : GCDGraph) (V' W' : Finset ℕ) (E' : Finset (ℕ × ℕ))
    (hV : V' ⊆ G.V) (hW : W' ⊆ G.W) (hE : E' ⊆ G.E) (hE' : E' ⊆ V' ×ˢ W') :
    (G.induce V' W' E' hV hW hE hE').quality =
      esum G.μ E' ^ 10 / (wsum G.μ V' ^ 9 * wsum G.μ W' ^ 9) * ∏ p ∈ G.P, G.qualityFactor p

statement: theorem alt_prodqf_pos (G : GCDGraph) : 0 < ∏ p ∈ G.P, G.qualityFactor p

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.alt_real_remove
statement:
theorem alt_real_remove (X Y e a n : ℝ) (hY : 0 < Y) (ha : 0 ≤ a) (haX : a ≤ X) (he : 0 < e)
    (heXY : e ≤ X * Y) (hlt : n < 9 * (e / (X * Y)) / 10 * Y) (he' : e - a * n ≤ (X - a) * Y) :
    e / (X * Y) ≤ (e - a * n) / ((X - a) * Y) ∧
    (e / (X * Y)) ^ 10 * X * Y ≤ ((e - a * n) / ((X - a) * Y)) ^ 10 * (X - a) * Y

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.alt_real_sparse
statement:
theorem alt_real_sparse (S T e e1 A B η : ℝ) (hA : 0 < A) (hB : 0 < B)
    (hAS : A ≤ η * S) (hBT : B ≤ η * T) (he : 0 ≤ e) (hη : 0 < η)
    (he1 : η ^ ((9 : ℝ) / 5) * e < e1) :
    e ^ 10 / (S ^ 9 * T ^ 9) ≤ e1 ^ 10 / (A ^ 9 * B ^ 9)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.alt_step10
statement:
theorem alt_step10 (G : GCDGraph) (hδ : 0 < G.density) (hH : ¬ G.HighDegree) :
    ∃ G1 : GCDGraph, G1.IsSubgraph G ∧ G1.P = G.P ∧ G1.f = G.f ∧ G1.g = G.g ∧
      G1.V.card + G1.W.card < G.V.card + G.W.card ∧ G.density ≤ G1.density ∧
      G.quality ≤ G1.quality

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.alt_step115
statement:
theorem alt_step115 (G : GCDGraph) (hδ : 0 < G.density) (η : ℝ) (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1)
    (hA : ¬ ∀ A ⊆ G.V, ∀ B ⊆ G.W, wsum G.μ A ≤ η * wsum G.μ G.V → wsum G.μ B ≤ η * wsum G.μ G.W →
        esum G.μ (G.E.filter (fun e => e.1 ∈ A ∧ e.2 ∈ B)) ≤ η ^ ((9 : ℝ) / 5) * esum G.μ G.E) :
    ∃ G1 : GCDGraph, G1.IsSubgraph G ∧ G1.P = G.P ∧ G1.f = G.f ∧ G1.g = G.g ∧
      G1.V.card + G1.W.card < G.V.card + G.W.card ∧ 0 < G1.density ∧
      G.quality ≤ G1.quality

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.exists_addPrime_zero
statement:
theorem exists_addPrime_zero (G : GCDGraph) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpP : p ∉ G.P)
    (hpR : p ∉ G.R) :
    ∃ G' : GCDGraph, G'.IsSubgraph G ∧ G'.V = G.V ∧ G'.W = G.W ∧ G'.E = G.E ∧
      G'.P = insert p G.P ∧ G'.f p = 0 ∧ G'.g p = 0 ∧ G'.R ⊆ G.R.erase p ∧
      G.quality ≤ G'.quality ∧ G'.density = G.density

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.exists_block_subgraph
statement:
theorem exists_block_subgraph (G : GCDGraph) (hδ : 0 < G.density) (I J : Finset ℕ)
    (iV jW : ℕ → ℕ) (hI : ∀ v ∈ G.V, iV v ∈ I) (hJ : ∀ w ∈ G.W, jW w ∈ J) :
    ∃ i ∈ I, ∃ j ∈ J, ∃ G' : GCDGraph, G'.IsSubgraph G ∧
      G'.V = G.V.filter (fun v => iV v = i) ∧ G'.W = G.W.filter (fun w => jW w = j) ∧
      G'.E = G.E.filter (fun e => iV e.1 = i ∧ jW e.2 = j) ∧
      G'.P = G.P ∧ G'.f = G.f ∧ G'.g = G.g ∧ 0 < G'.density ∧
      G.density / ((I.card : ℝ) * J.card) ≤ G'.density ∧
      G.quality / ((I.card : ℝ) * J.card) ^ 10 ≤ G'.quality

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.exists_highDegree_subgraph
statement:
theorem exists_highDegree_subgraph (G : GCDGraph) (hδ : 0 < G.density) :
    ∃ G' : GCDGraph, G'.IsSubgraph G ∧ G'.P = G.P ∧ G'.f = G.f ∧ G'.g = G.g ∧
      0 < G'.density ∧ G.density ≤ G'.density ∧ G.quality ≤ G'.quality ∧ G'.HighDegree

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.exists_sparse_small_sets_subgraph
statement:
theorem exists_sparse_small_sets_subgraph (G : GCDGraph) (hδ : 0 < G.density) (η : ℝ)
    (hη0 : 0 < η) (hη1 : η < 1) :
    ∃ G' : GCDGraph, G'.IsSubgraph G ∧ G'.P = G.P ∧ G'.f = G.f ∧ G'.g = G.g ∧
      0 < G'.density ∧ G.quality ≤ G'.quality ∧
      ∀ A ⊆ G'.V, ∀ B ⊆ G'.W, wsum G.μ A ≤ η * wsum G.μ G'.V → wsum G.μ B ≤ η * wsum G.μ G'.W →
        esum G.μ (G'.E.filter (fun e => e.1 ∈ A ∧ e.2 ∈ B)) ≤ η ^ ((9 : ℝ) / 5) * esum G.μ G'.E

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.quality_eq
statement:
theorem quality_eq (G : GCDGraph) :
    G.quality = esum G.μ G.E ^ 10 / (wsum G.μ G.V ^ 9 * wsum G.μ G.W ^ 9) *
      ∏ p ∈ G.P, G.qualityFactor p

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.quality_nonneg
statement: theorem quality_nonneg (G : GCDGraph) : 0 ≤ G.quality

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.quality_pos_iff
statement: theorem quality_pos_iff (G : GCDGraph) : 0 < G.quality ↔ 0 < G.density

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.quality_restrictPrime
statement:
theorem quality_restrictPrime (G : GCDGraph) (p k l : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpP : p ∉ G.P)
    (hE : 0 < esum G.μ G.E) (hV : 0 < wsum G.μ (vslice G.V p k))
    (hW : 0 < wsum G.μ (vslice G.W p l)) :
    (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).quality =
      G.quality * (esum G.μ (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).E / esum G.μ G.E) ^ 10 *
        (wsum G.μ G.V / wsum G.μ (vslice G.V p k)) ^ 9 *
        (wsum G.μ G.W / wsum G.μ (vslice G.W p l)) ^ 9 *
        ((p : ℝ) ^ ((k - l) + (l - k)) /
          ((1 - (if k = l ∧ 1 ≤ k then 1 / (p : ℝ) else 0)) ^ 2 *
            (1 - 1 / (p : ℝ) ^ ((31 : ℝ) / 30)) ^ 10))

statement:

theorem lemma84 (G : GCDGraph) (t : ℝ) (ht : T0 ≤ t) (hδ : 0 < G.density)

      G'.g = G.g ∧ 0 < G'.quality ∧ G.quality / 2 ≤ G'.quality ∧
      ∀ e ∈ G'.E, 5 ≤ ∑ p ∈ (coprimePart e.1 e.2).primeFactors.filter

theorem alt_gp_sharp_real (ak bk al bl η : ℝ) (hak0 : 0 ≤ ak) (hbk0 : 0 ≤ bk) (hal0 : 0 ≤ al)

statement:
theorem lemma122 (G : GCDGraph) (hδ : 0 < G.density) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpP : p ∉ G.P)
    (hpK : K40 < p) :
    (∃ k l : ℕ, 0 < (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).density ∧
        (2 : ℝ) ^ (if k ≠ l then 1 else 0) ≤

      G'.R ⊂ G.R ∧
      (2 : ℝ) ^ (newUnequal G' G) ≤ min 1 (G'.density / G.density) * (G'.quality / G.quality)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.Unbalanced.conclude
statement:
lemma conclude (G : GCDGraph) (hδ : 0 < G.density) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpP : p ∉ G.P)
    (r k l : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hpr : T0 < (p : ℝ) ^ r) (hdist : r + 1 ≤ (k - l) + (l - k))
    (hX : 1 / 100 * ((2 : ℝ) ^ (-(1 : ℝ) / 20)) ^ ((k - l) + (l - k)) *
        (esum G.μ G.E / (4 * (p : ℝ) ^ ((31 : ℝ) / 30))) <
      esum G.μ (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).E)
    (hsmall : (p : ℝ) * wsum G.μ (vslice G.V p k) ≤ K40 * wsum G.μ G.V ∨
      (p : ℝ) * wsum G.μ (vslice G.W p l) ≤ K40 * wsum G.μ G.W) :
    2 * G.quality < (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).quality ∧
      2 * G.density * G.quality <
        (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).density * (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).quality

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.lemma113
statement:
theorem lemma113 (G : GCDGraph) (hδ : 0 < G.density) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpP : p ∉ G.P)
    (r k : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hpr : T0 < (p : ℝ) ^ r)
    (hW : (1 - K40 / p) * wsum G.μ G.W ≤ wsum G.μ (vslice G.W p k)) :
    (∃ l : ℕ, r + 1 ≤ (k - l) + (l - k) ∧
        2 * G.quality < (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).quality ∧
        2 * G.density * G.quality <
          (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).density * (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).quality) ∨
      esum G.μ (G.E.filter (fun e => e.1.factorization p = k ∧
          r + 1 ≤ (k - e.2.factorization p) + (e.2.factorization p - k))) ≤
        esum G.μ G.E / (4 * (p : ℝ) ^ ((31 : ℝ) / 30))

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.lemma114
statement:
theorem lemma114 (G : GCDGraph) (hδ : 0 < G.density) (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpP : p ∉ G.P)
    (r l : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (hpr : T0 < (p : ℝ) ^ r)
    (hV : (1 - K40 / p) * wsum G.μ G.V ≤ wsum G.μ (vslice G.V p l)) :
    (∃ k : ℕ, r + 1 ≤ (k - l) + (l - k) ∧
        2 * G.quality < (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).quality ∧
        2 * G.density * G.quality <
          (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).density * (G.restrictPrime p k l hp hpP).quality) ∨
      esum G.μ (G.E.filter (fun e => e.2.factorization p = l ∧
          r + 1 ≤ (e.1.factorization p - l) + (l - e.1.factorization p))) ≤
        esum G.μ G.E / (4 * (p : ℝ) ^ ((31 : ℝ) / 30))

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.alt_sh_contra
statement:
theorem alt_sh_contra (G1 : GCDGraph) (p k : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpP1 : p ∉ G1.P)
    (hpT : T0 ≤ (p : ℝ)) (hp0 : (0 : ℝ) < p) (hp2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ p) (hq1 : 0 < G1.quality)
    (hE1 : 0 < esum G1.μ G1.E) (hV1 : 0 < wsum G1.μ G1.V) (hW1 : 0 < wsum G1.μ G1.W)
    (η : ℝ) (hη : η = K40 / p) (hη1 : η < 1)
    (hVk : (1 - η) * wsum G1.μ G1.V ≤ wsum G1.μ (vslice G1.V p k))
    (hWk : (1 - η) * wsum G1.μ G1.W ≤ wsum G1.μ (vslice G1.W p k))
    (c : ℝ) (hc : c = 1 / (p : ℝ) ^ ((31 : ℝ) / 30)) (hc0 : 0 < c) (hc2 : c ≤ 1 / 2)
    (hcov' : 1 ≤ esum G1.μ (alt_sh_plus G1 p k hp hpP1).E / esum G1.μ G1.E +
      esum G1.μ (G1.E.filter (fun e => e.1.factorization p = k ∧ e.2.factorization p + 1 = k)) /
        esum G1.μ G1.E +
      esum G1.μ (G1.E.filter (fun e => e.1.factorization p + 1 = k ∧ e.2.factorization p = k)) /
        esum G1.μ G1.E + c / 2 + η ^ ((9 : ℝ) / 5))
    (hGp_good : (alt_sh_plus G1 p k hp hpP1).quality < G1.quality)
    (hA : ¬ (1 ≤ k ∧ 0 < wsum G1.μ (G1.W.filter (fun w => w.factorization p + 1 = k)) ∧
      G1.quality ≤ (G1.restrictPrime p k (k - 1) hp hpP1).quality))
    (hB : ¬ (1 ≤ k ∧ 0 < wsum G1.μ (G1.V.filter (fun v => v.factorization p + 1 = k)) ∧
      G1.quality ≤ (G1.restrictPrime p (k - 1) k hp hpP1).quality)) : False

name: DuffinSchaeffer.GCDGraph.alt_sh_cover
statement:
theorem alt_sh_cover (G G1 : GCDGraph) (p k : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hpP1 : p ∉ G1.P)
    (hμ1 : G1.μ = G.μ) (hE1 : 0 < esum G1.μ G1.E) (η : ℝ)
    (hVk : (1 - η) * wsum G1.μ G1.V ≤ wsum G1.μ (vslice G1.V p k))
    (hWk : (1 - η) * wsum G1.μ G1.W ≤ wsum G1.μ (vslice G1.W p k))
    (hsp : ∀ A ⊆ G1.V, ∀ B ⊆ G1.W, wsum G.μ A ≤ η * wsum G.μ G1.V →
      wsum G.μ B ≤ η * wsum G.μ G1.W →
      esum G.μ (G1.E.filter (fun e => e.1 ∈ A ∧ e.2 ∈ B)) ≤ η ^ ((9 : ℝ) / 5) * esum G.μ G1.E)
    (c : ℝ) (hc : c = 1 / (p : ℝ) ^ ((31 : ℝ) / 30))
    (hbad1 : esum G1.μ (G1.E.filter (fun e => e.1.factorization p = k ∧
      1 + 1 ≤ (k - e.2.factorization p) + (e.2.factorization p - k))) ≤
        esum G1.μ G1.E / (4 * (p : ℝ) ^ ((31 : ℝ) / 30)))
    (hbad2 : esum G1.μ (G1.E.filter (fun e => e.2.factorization p = k ∧
      1 + 1 ≤ (e.1.factorization p - k) + (k - e.1.factorization p))) ≤
        esum G1.μ G1.E / (4 * (p : ℝ) ^ ((31 : ℝ) / 30))) :
    1 ≤ esum G1.μ (alt_sh_plus G1 p k hp hpP1).E / esum G1.μ G1.E +
      esum G1.μ (G1.E.filter (fun e => e.1.factorization p = k ∧ e.2.factorization p + 1 = k)) /
        esum G1.μ G1.E +
      esum G1.μ (G1.E.filter (fun e => e.1.factorization p + 1 = k ∧ e.2.factorization p = k)) /
        esum G1.μ G1.E + c / 2 + η ^ ((9 : ℝ) / 5)

statement:

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt63_count
statement:
theorem alt63_count (S : Finset ℕ) (a M : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (bad : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred bad]
    (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcount : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → (((Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter bad).card : ℝ) ≤ D * x)
    (hS : ∀ v ∈ S, 0 < v ∧ a ∣ v ∧ v ≤ M ∧ bad (v / a)) :
    (S.card : ℝ) ≤ D * ((M : ℝ) / a)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt63_esum_eq
statement:
theorem alt63_esum_eq (G : GCDGraph) :
    esum G.μ G.E = G.density * (wsum G.μ G.V * wsum G.μ G.W)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt63_exp_le_one_sub
statement:
theorem alt63_exp_le_one_sub (x : ℝ) (hx0 : 0 ≤ x) (hx : x ≤ 1 / 2) :
    Real.exp (-2 * x) ≤ 1 - x

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt63_fiber
statement:
theorem alt63_fiber (H : GCDGraph) (ψ : ℕ → ℝ) (hψ : ∀ q, 0 ≤ ψ q) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (m : ℕ) (hM : ∀ e ∈ H.E, Mqr ψ e.1 e.2 ≤ t * m) (bad : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred bad]
    (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcount : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → (((Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter bad).card : ℝ) ≤ D * x)
    (w : ℕ) (F : Finset (ℕ × ℕ)) (hF : ∀ e ∈ F, e ∈ H.E ∧ e.2 = w ∧ bad (e.1 / H.aProd)) :
    (F.card : ℝ) * ψ w ≤ D * t * m / H.aProd

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt63_prod_dvd
statement:
theorem alt63_prod_dvd (P : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) (v : ℕ) (hv : v ≠ 0)
    (hd : ∀ p ∈ P, p ^ f p ∣ v) : (∏ p ∈ P, p ^ f p) ∣ v

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt63_prod_fact
statement:
theorem alt63_prod_fact (P : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) (q : ℕ) :
    (∏ p ∈ P, p ^ f p).factorization q = if q ∈ P then f q else 0

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt63_prod_pos
statement:
theorem alt63_prod_pos (P : Finset ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℕ) (hP : ∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) :
    0 < ∏ p ∈ P, p ^ f p

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt63_sum_fst
statement:
theorem alt63_sum_fst (H : GCDGraph) (ψ : ℕ → ℝ) (hψ : ∀ q, 0 ≤ ψ q) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (m : ℕ) (hM : ∀ e ∈ H.E, Mqr ψ e.1 e.2 ≤ t * m) (bad : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred bad]
    (D : ℝ) (hD : 0 ≤ D)
    (hcount : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 ≤ x → (((Icc 1 ⌊x⌋₊).filter bad).card : ℝ) ≤ D * x) :
    ∑ e ∈ H.E.filter (fun e => bad (e.1 / H.aProd)), ψ e.2 ≤
      H.W.card * (D * t * m / H.aProd)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt63_sum_snd
statement:
theorem alt63_sum_snd (H : GCDGraph) (ψ : ℕ → ℝ) (hψ : ∀ q, 0 ≤ ψ q) (t : ℝ) (ht : 0 ≤ t)
    (m : ℕ) (hM : ∀ e ∈ H.E, Mqr ψ e.1 e.2 ≤ t * m) (bad : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred bad] :
    ∑ e ∈ H.E.filter (fun e => bad (e.2 / H.bProd)), ψ e.2 ≤
      (H.W.filter (fun w => bad (w / H.bProd))).card * (t * m / H.aProd)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt63_totient_real
statement:
theorem alt63_totient_real (n : ℕ) :
    (Nat.totient n : ℝ) = n * ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, (1 - (p : ℝ)⁻¹)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.UnitPairCountAux.card_filter_crt
statement:
lemma card_filter_crt (m n : ℕ) (hm : m ≠ 0) (hn : n ≠ 0) (co : Nat.Coprime m n)
    (Q1 Q2 : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred Q1] [DecidablePred Q2] :
    ((range (m * n)).filter (fun s => Q1 (s % m) ∧ Q2 (s % n))).card =
      ((range m).filter Q1).card * ((range n).filter Q2).card

name: DuffinSchaeffer.UnitPairCountAux.card_filter_range_mul_mod
statement:
lemma card_filter_range_mul_mod (Q : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred Q] (d k : ℕ) :
    ((range (d * k)).filter (fun s => Q (s % d))).card = k * ((range d).filter Q).card

name: DuffinSchaeffer.UnitPairCountAux.exists_root
statement: lemma exists_root (p c e : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (he : ¬ p ∣ e) : ∃ x < p, p ∣ c + e * x

name: DuffinSchaeffer.UnitPairCountAux.fA_pos
statement: lemma fA_pos {p : ℕ} (hp : p.Prime) : 0 < fA p

name: DuffinSchaeffer.UnitPairCountAux.per_prime
statement:
lemma per_prime (p x y z good : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (h1 : good + 1 ≤ p)
    (h2 : ¬ p ∣ x → ¬ p ∣ y → ¬ p ∣ z → good + 2 ≤ p) :
    (good : ℝ) / p ≤ cfac x y z p

name: DuffinSchaeffer.UnitPairCountAux.prod_fA_pos
statement: lemma prod_fA_pos (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ p ∈ s, p.Prime) : 0 < ∏ p ∈ s, fA p

name: DuffinSchaeffer.UnitPairCountAux.prod_inter_ite
statement:
lemma prod_inter_ite (g x : ℕ) (hx : x ≠ 0) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∏ p ∈ g.primeFactors ∩ x.primeFactors, f p =
      ∏ p ∈ g.primeFactors, (if p ∣ x then f p else 1)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.UnitPairCountAux.prod_ite_pos
statement:
lemma prod_ite_pos (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ p ∈ s, p.Prime) (x : ℕ) :
    0 < ∏ p ∈ s, (if p ∣ x then fA p else 1)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.UnitPairCountAux.prod_of_dvd
statement:
lemma prod_of_dvd (g d : ℕ) (hg : g ≠ 0) (hdg : d ∣ g) (f : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ∏ p ∈ d.primeFactors, f p = ∏ p ∈ g.primeFactors, (if p ∣ d then f p else 1)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.UnitPairCountAux.sieve
statement:
lemma sieve (F : ℕ → ℕ) (hF : ∀ p s, p ∣ F s ↔ p ∣ F (s % p)) :
    ∀ P : Finset ℕ, (∀ p ∈ P, p.Prime) →
      ((range (∏ p ∈ P, p)).filter (fun s => ∀ p ∈ P, ¬ p ∣ F s)).card =
        ∏ p ∈ P, ((range p).filter (fun x => ¬ p ∣ F x)).card

name: DuffinSchaeffer.UnitPairCountAux.totient_div_eq
statement:
lemma totient_div_eq (n : ℕ) (hn : n ≠ 0) :
    (Nat.totient n : ℝ) / n = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, fA p

name: DuffinSchaeffer.ovl_arith
statement:
theorem ovl_arith (q r a b : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) :
    (a : ℝ) / q - b / r =
      (((a : ℤ) * ((r / Nat.gcd q r : ℕ) : ℤ) - (b : ℤ) * ((q / Nat.gcd q r : ℕ) : ℤ) : ℤ) : ℝ) /
        (Nat.lcm q r : ℝ)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.ovl_ball_inter_le
statement:
theorem ovl_ball_inter_le (x y : UnitAddCircle) {δ ε : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) (hε : 0 ≤ ε) :
    volume.real (Metric.ball x δ ∩ Metric.ball y ε) ≤ 2 * min δ ε

name: DuffinSchaeffer.ovl_cover
statement:
theorem ovl_cover (ψ : ℕ → ℝ) (q r : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r) :
    Aq ψ q ∩ Aq ψ r ⊆ ⋃ ab ∈ ((range q ×ˢ range r).filter (fun ab : ℕ × ℕ =>
        Nat.Coprime ab.1 q ∧ Nat.Coprime ab.2 r ∧
        dist (((ab.1 : ℝ) / q : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) (((ab.2 : ℝ) / r : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) <
          ψ q / q + ψ r / r)),
      Metric.ball (((ab.1 : ℝ) / q : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) (ψ q / q) ∩
        Metric.ball (((ab.2 : ℝ) / r : ℝ) : UnitAddCircle) (ψ r / r)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.ovl_prod_Icc
statement:
theorem ovl_prod_Icc (N : ℕ) (hN : 1 ≤ N) :
    ∏ n ∈ Icc 2 N, (1 - 1 / (n : ℝ) ^ 2) = ((N : ℝ) + 1) / (2 * (N : ℝ))

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt_Pfac_le
statement:
theorem alt_Pfac_le (ψ : ℕ → ℝ) (hψ : ∀ q, 0 ≤ ψ q) (q r J : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (hr : 0 < r)
    (hJ : q * r ≤ J) :
    Pfac ψ q r ≤ Real.exp 200 + ∑ j ∈ range J,
      (if (Mqr ψ q r ≤ alt_tt j * Nat.gcd q r ∧ 10 ≤ Lsum (alt_tt j) q r)
        then Real.exp 158 * Real.exp j else 0)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt_log_tt
statement: theorem alt_log_tt (j : ℕ) : Real.log (alt_tt j) = Real.exp j

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt_sum_exp_div_le
statement:
theorem alt_sum_exp_div_le (J : ℕ) :
    ∑ j ∈ range J, Real.exp j / alt_tt j ≤ 2

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt_sum_low_le
statement:
theorem alt_sum_low_le (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) (T : ℝ) (hT : 2 ≤ T) :
    ∑ p ∈ S.filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < T), (1 : ℝ) / p ≤
      1 / 2 + (Real.log (Real.log T / Real.log 2) + 100 / Real.log 2)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt_sum_mid_le
statement:
theorem alt_sum_mid_le (S : Finset ℕ) (hS : ∀ p ∈ S, p.Prime) (s T : ℝ) (hs : 2 ≤ s)
    (hsT : s ≤ T) :
    ∑ p ∈ (S.filter (fun p : ℕ => s < (p : ℝ))).filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < T),
        (1 : ℝ) / p ≤ Real.log (Real.log T / Real.log s) + 100 / Real.log s

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt_sum_split
statement:
theorem alt_sum_split (S : Finset ℕ) (P : ℕ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (T : ℝ) :
    ∑ p ∈ S.filter P, (1 : ℝ) / p ≤
      ∑ p ∈ (S.filter P).filter (fun p : ℕ => (p : ℝ) < T), (1 : ℝ) / p +
        ∑ p ∈ S.filter (fun p : ℕ => T ≤ (p : ℝ)), (1 : ℝ) / p

name: DuffinSchaeffer.alt_tt_ge_two
statement: theorem alt_tt_ge_two (j : ℕ) : 2 ≤ alt_tt j

name: DuffinSchaeffer.chungErdos_quadratic
statement:
theorem chungErdos_quadratic {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (A : ℕ → Set Ω) (hA : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (A n)) (F : Finset ℕ)
    (t : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ ∑ n ∈ F, ∑ m ∈ F, μ.real (A n ∩ A m) - 2 * t * ∑ n ∈ F, μ.real (A n)
      + t ^ 2 * μ.real (⋃ n ∈ F, A n)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.measure_limsup_ge_of_second_moment
statement:
theorem measure_limsup_ge_of_second_moment {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (A : ℕ → Set Ω) (hA : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (A n)) (C : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ N : ℕ, ∃ F : Finset ℕ, (∀ n ∈ F, N ≤ n) ∧ 0 < ∑ n ∈ F, μ.real (A n) ∧
      ∑ n ∈ F, ∑ m ∈ F, μ.real (A n ∩ A m) ≤ C * (∑ n ∈ F, μ.real (A n)) ^ 2) :
    1 / C ≤ μ.real (limsup A atTop)

name: DuffinSchaeffer.one_div_le_measure_biUnion
statement:
theorem one_div_le_measure_biUnion {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] (μ : Measure Ω)
    [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (A : ℕ → Set Ω) (hA : ∀ n, MeasurableSet (A n)) (F : Finset ℕ)
    (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (hS : 0 < ∑ n ∈ F, μ.real (A n))
    (hD : ∑ n ∈ F, ∑ m ∈ F, μ.real (A n ∩ A m) ≤ C * (∑ n ∈ F, μ.real (A n)) ^ 2) :
    1 / C ≤ μ.real (⋃ n ∈ F, A n)

name: Erdos1199.ramsey_pairs

name: Erdos1199.hindman_local
statement:
theorem hindman_local (c : ℕ → Bool) (j : Bool)
    (hno : ¬ ∃ B : Set ℕ, B.Infinite ∧ ∀ x ∈ B, ∀ y ∈ B, c (x + y) = j) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ K M x : ℕ,
      ((Finset.range M).filter (fun s => c (2 * (K + s)) = !j)).card ≤ 1 →
      C < x → 2 * K < x → x + C < 2 * (K + M) → c (2 * x) = !j

name: Erdos265.block_approx
statement:
theorem block_approx (k : ℕ) (δ : ℝ × ℝ) (h1 : |δ.1| ≤ rad1 k) (h2 : |δ.2| ≤ rad2 k) :
    ∃ c : ℤ × ℤ, Adm k c ∧
      |(center k).1 + δ.1 - (blockVal k c).1| ≤ 16 / (NN k : ℝ) ^ 2 ∧

statement:
theorem int_scale (ha : IsRationalPair a) :
    ∃ b d : ℕ, 0 < b ∧ 0 < d ∧
      (∀ n, ∃ z : ℤ, ((b * P a n : ℕ) : ℝ) * T a n = z) ∧
      (∀ n, ∃ z : ℤ, ((d * Ps a n : ℕ) : ℝ) * V a n = z)

name: Erdos265.int_scale_aux
statement:
theorem int_scale_aux (c : ℕ → ℕ) (hc : ∀ k, 1 ≤ c k)
    (hs : Summable (fun k => (1 : ℝ) / (c k : ℝ))) (q : ℚ)
    (hq : ∑' k, (1 : ℝ) / (c k : ℝ) = (q : ℝ)) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ z : ℤ, ((q.den * ∏ k ∈ Finset.range n, c k : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      tail (fun k => (1 : ℝ) / (c k : ℝ)) n = z

statement:
theorem T_split (ha : IsRationalPair a) (n M : ℕ) :

theorem exp_neg_ceil_log_le {x : ℝ} (hx : 0 < x) :

name: Erdos265.far_tail_le
statement:
theorem far_tail_le (ha : IsRationalPair a) {N n M : ℕ} (hn : N ≤ n)
    (hN : ∀ m ≥ N, Real.exp (m : ℝ) ≤ (a m : ℝ)) :
    ∑' k, recip a (k + M + n) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(M : ℝ))

name: Erdos265.far_term_le
statement:
theorem far_term_le {N n M k : ℕ} (hn : N ≤ n)
    (hN : ∀ m ≥ N, Real.exp (m : ℝ) ≤ (a m : ℝ)) :
    recip a (k + M + n) ≤ Real.exp (-(M : ℝ)) * Real.exp (-1) ^ k

    ∀ᶠ n in atTop, T a n ≤ regF a n / (a n : ℝ)

name: Erdos265.majorant_vanish
statement:
theorem majorant_vanish (ha : IsRationalPair a) {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 < ℓ)
    (hlim : Tendsto (logRatio (Henv a)) atTop (𝓝 ℓ)) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ (P a n : ℝ) ^ 2 * (regF a n / (a n : ℝ)) *
      (regF a (n + 1) / (a (n + 1) : ℝ))) atTop (𝓝 0)

statement:
lemma mv_Dt_le_two_T (ha : IsRationalPair a) (n : ℕ) :

statement:

name: Erdos265.mv_logD_upper
statement:
lemma mv_logD_upper (ha : IsRationalPair a) {n : ℕ} (hT : T a n ≤ regF a n / (a n : ℝ)) :

statement:
lemma mv_logH (ha : IsRationalPair a) (n : ℕ) :

statement: lemma mv_one_le_P (ha : IsRationalPair a) (n : ℕ) : 1 ≤ P a n

name: Erdos265.nested_boxes
statement:
theorem nested_boxes {ι : Type*} (G : ℕ → ι → ℝ × ℝ) (adm : ℕ → ι → Prop)
    (s : ℕ → ℝ × ℝ) (r1 r2 : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hs1 : Summable (fun k ↦ (s k).1)) (hs2 : Summable (fun k ↦ (s k).2))
    (hr1 : Tendsto r1 atTop (𝓝 0)) (hr2 : Tendsto r2 atTop (𝓝 0))
    (hG : ∀ k i, adm k i → 0 ≤ (G k i).1 ∧ 0 ≤ (G k i).2)
    (hstep : ∀ k (δ : ℝ × ℝ), |δ.1| ≤ r1 k → |δ.2| ≤ r2 k →
      ∃ i, adm k i ∧ |(s k).1 + δ.1 - (G k i).1| ≤ r1 (k + 1) ∧
        |(s k).2 + δ.2 - (G k i).2| ≤ r2 (k + 1))
    (x : ℝ × ℝ) (hx1 : |x.1 - ∑' k, (s k).1| ≤ r1 0) (hx2 : |x.2 - ∑' k, (s k).2| ≤ r2 0) :
    ∃ c : ℕ → ι, (∀ k, adm k (c k)) ∧ HasSum (fun k ↦ (G k (c k)).1) x.1 ∧
      HasSum (fun k ↦ (G k (c k)).2) x.2

name: Erdos265.quad_limit
statement:
theorem quad_limit {H : ℕ → ℝ} (h1 : ∀ n, 1 ≤ H n) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K)
    (hrec : ∀ᶠ n in atTop, H (n + 1) ≤ K * H n ^ 2) :
    ∃ ℓ : ℝ, 0 ≤ ℓ ∧ Tendsto (logRatio H) atTop (𝓝 ℓ)

name: Erdos265.Eres_pos_of

statement:
lemma recipS_eq_recip (ha : IsRationalPair a) (m : ℕ) :

name: Erdos265.recip_pos'
statement: lemma recip_pos' (ha : IsRationalPair a) (m : ℕ) : 0 < recip a m

name: Erdos265.residual_alg
statement:
lemma residual_alg {x y : ℝ} (hx : 0 ≤ x) (hy : 0 ≤ y) (hs : x + y ≤ 1 / 2) :
    (x + y) / (1 - (x + y)) - x / (1 - x) - y ≤ 8 * (x + y) * y

name: Erdos265.residual_upper
statement:
theorem residual_upper (ha : IsRationalPair a) :

statement:

theorem center_summable :

statement:
theorem isRationalPair_of_blocks {c : ℕ → ℤ × ℤ} (hc : ∀ k, Adm k (c k)) {x1 x2 : ℚ}
    (h1 : HasSum (fun k ↦ (blockVal k (c k)).1) (x1 : ℝ))

statement:
theorem bounded_j (s : ℕ) (hs : 2 ≤ s) (J : ℕ) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n j : ℕ, N ≤ n → j < J → gfsPoly s n j ≠ 0

name: Erdos494.dvd_factorial_mul_choose
statement:
lemma dvd_factorial_mul_choose (n t m : ℕ) (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hmt : m ≤ t) :

name: Erdos494.gfs_dvd
statement:
theorem gfs_dvd (s n j : ℕ) (hs : 1 ≤ s) (_hn : 0 < n) (h : gfsPoly s n j = 0) :

name: Erdos494.exactCase_bernoulli
statement: lemma exactCase_bernoulli (m : ℕ) : 2 ^ m * (m + 2) ≤ 2 * 3 ^ m

name: Erdos494.exactCase_choose_mul_pow_le
statement:
lemma exactCase_choose_mul_pow_le (n s : ℕ) :
    ∀ t k, k + t ≤ s → n.choose k * (n - s) ^ t ≤ s ^ t * n.choose (k + t)

name: Erdos494.exactCase_le_two_pow
statement: lemma exactCase_le_two_pow (i : ℕ) (hi : 4 ≤ i) : i ≤ 2 ^ (i - 2)

name: Erdos494.exactCase_one
statement:
lemma exactCase_one (s m : ℕ) (hs : 3 ≤ s) (hm : 2 ≤ m)
    (hK : 2 ^ m * (1 + s ^ (s + 1)) < 3 ^ m) :
    0 < gfsPoly s ((s - 1) * 2 ^ m) (m + 1)

name: Erdos494.exactCase_one'
statement:
lemma exactCase_one' (r m n : ℕ) (hm : 2 ≤ m) (hn : n = (r + 2) * 2 ^ m)
    (hK : 2 ^ m * (1 + (r + 3) ^ (r + 3 + 1)) < 3 ^ m) :
    0 < gfsPoly (r + 3) n (m + 1)

name: Erdos494.exactCase_term_le
statement:
lemma exactCase_term_le (s n m i : ℕ) (hi4 : 4 ≤ i) (his : i ≤ s) (hn : 2 ^ m ≤ n - s) :
    i ^ m * n.choose (s - i) ≤ 2 ^ m * s ^ s * n.choose (s - 3)

name: Erdos494.exact_case
statement:
theorem exact_case (s : ℕ) (hs : 3 ≤ s) :
    ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n j i : ℕ, N ≤ n → 1 ≤ j → i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (s - 1) →
      n * i ^ (j - 1) = (s - i) * (i + 1) ^ (j - 1) → gfsPoly s n j ≠ 0

name: Erdos494.GfsRecursionAux.g_succ
statement: lemma g_succ (n m : ℕ) : g n (m + 1) = (n.choose m : ℤ) - g n m

name: Erdos494.GfsRecursionAux.key
statement: lemma key (n m : ℕ) : (m : ℤ) * (n.choose m : ℤ) = (n : ℤ) * g n m

name: Erdos494.GfsRecursionAux.sum_Icc_one_eq_range
statement:
lemma sum_Icc_one_eq_range {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (m : ℕ) (F : ℕ → M) :
    ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 m, F i = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range m, F (i + 1)

name: Erdos494.gfs_recursion
statement:
theorem gfs_recursion (n j k : ℕ) (hj : 1 ≤ j) (hk : 1 ≤ k) :
    (k : ℤ) * gfsPoly k n j =
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 k, (-1) ^ (i + 1) *
        ((n : ℤ) * gfsPoly (k - i) n j + (n.choose (k - i) : ℤ) * (i : ℤ) ^ j)

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.E_add
statement: lemma E_add (a b : ℂ) : E a * E b = E (a + b)

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.E_pow
statement: lemma E_pow (c : ℂ) (i : ℕ) : E c ^ i = E ((i : ℂ) * c)

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.E_zero
statement: lemma E_zero : E 0 = 1

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.G_zero

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.coeff_E
statement: lemma coeff_E (c : ℂ) (m : ℕ) : coeff m (E c) = c ^ m / (m.factorial : ℂ)

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.coeff_G
statement: lemma coeff_G (A : Finset ℂ) (k m : ℕ) : coeff m (G A k) = q A k m / (m.factorial : ℂ)

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.coeff_G_zero
statement: lemma coeff_G_zero (A : Finset ℂ) (k : ℕ) : coeff 0 (G A k) = (A.card.choose k : ℂ)

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.coeff_P
statement:
lemma coeff_P (A : Finset ℂ) (i v : ℕ) :
    coeff v (P A i) = (i : ℂ) ^ v * psum A v / (v.factorial : ℂ)

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.coeff_P_zero
statement: lemma coeff_P_zero (A : Finset ℂ) (i : ℕ) : coeff 0 (P A i) = (A.card : ℂ)

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.ksumPsum_eq
statement: lemma ksumPsum_eq (A : Finset ℂ) (k m : ℕ) : ksumPsum A k m = q A k m

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.newton
statement:
lemma newton (A : Finset ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    (k : ℂ⟦X⟧) * G A k = ∑ i ∈ Icc 1 k, (-1) ^ (i + 1) * G A (k - i) * P A i

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.prod_E
statement: lemma prod_E {ι : Type*} (t : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℂ) : ∏ i ∈ t, E (c i) = E (∑ i ∈ t, c i)

name: Erdos494.KSumAux.sum_powersetCard_subtype
statement:
lemma sum_powersetCard_subtype {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] (A : Finset ℂ) (r : ℕ)
    (F : ℂ → M) :
    ∑ t ∈ (univ : Finset A).powersetCard r, F (∑ i ∈ t, (i : ℂ)) =
      ∑ S ∈ A.powersetCard r, F (S.sum id)

name: Erdos494.ksum_power_sum
statement:
theorem ksum_power_sum (A B : Finset ℂ) (n s j : ℕ) (hA : A.card = n) (hB : B.card = n)
    (hj : 1 ≤ j) (h : ∀ l, 1 ≤ l → l < j → psum A l = psum B l) :
    ksumPsum A s j - ksumPsum B s j = (gfsPoly s n j : ℂ) * (psum A j - psum B j)

name: Erdos494.kruyt_counterexample
statement: theorem kruyt_counterexample : ∀ k > 2, ¬Erdos494Unique k k

name: Erdos494.sumMultiset_of_card_eq
statement:
lemma sumMultiset_of_card_eq (C : Finset ℂ) (k : ℕ) (hC : C.card = k) :
    sumMultiset C k = {C.sum id}

name: Erdos494.power_sums_determine
statement:
theorem power_sums_determine (A B : Finset ℂ) (n : ℕ) (hA : A.card = n) (hB : B.card = n)
    (h : ∀ j, 1 ≤ j → j ≤ n → psum A j = psum B j) : A = B

name: Erdos494.auxEntryN_le
statement:
lemma auxEntryN_le (r a b r1 r2 s i1 i2 k1 k2 : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hk1 : k1 ≤ r1) (hk2 : k2 ≤ r2) :
    auxEntryN r a b r1 r2 s i1 i2 k1 k2 ≤ (2 * max a b) ^ (r1 + r2)

name: Erdos494.aux_col_identity
statement:
lemma aux_col_identity (r a b r1 r2 i1 i2 k1 k2 : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (ha : 0 < a) (_hb : 0 < b)
    (hk : k1 + k2 ≤ r1 + r2) :
    ∑ s : Fin r, binRoot r a b ^ (s : ℕ) * ((auxEntryN r a b r1 r2 s i1 i2 k1 k2 : ℕ) : ℝ) =
      (a : ℝ) ^ ((r1 + r2) / r) * binRoot r a b ^ (i1 + i2) *
        ((k1.choose i1 : ℝ) * (k2.choose i2 : ℝ) * binRoot r a b ^ (k1 - i1) *
          binRoot r a b ^ (k2 - i2))

name: Erdos494.aux_polynomial
statement:
theorem aux_polynomial (r a b : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) :
    ∃ K : ℝ, 1 ≤ K ∧ ∀ r1 r2 : ℕ, 16 * r ≤ r2 → r2 ≤ r1 →
      ∃ c : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ, BoxNonzero r1 r2 c ∧ (∀ k1 k2, |(c k1 k2 : ℝ)| ≤ K ^ (r1 + r2)) ∧
        ∀ i1 i2 : ℕ, ((i1 : ℝ) / r1 + (i2 : ℝ) / r2) * (2 * Real.sqrt r) < 1 →
          hasseEval r1 r2 c i1 i2 (binRoot r a b) (binRoot r a b) = 0

name: Erdos494.binRoot_pos'
statement: lemma binRoot_pos' (r a b : ℕ) (ha : 0 < a) (hb : 0 < b) : 0 < binRoot r a b

name: Erdos494.binRoot_pow'
statement: lemma binRoot_pow' (r a b : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r) : binRoot r a b ^ r = (b : ℝ) / a

name: Erdos494.rational_lower_bound
statement:
theorem rational_lower_bound (r1 r2 : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) (i1 i2 : ℕ) (p1 p2 : ℤ) (q1 q2 : ℕ)
    (hq1 : 0 < q1) (hq2 : 0 < q2)
    (hne : hasseEval r1 r2 c i1 i2 ((p1 : ℝ) / q1) ((p2 : ℝ) / q2) ≠ 0) :
    1 ≤ (q1 : ℝ) ^ r1 * (q2 : ℝ) ^ r2 *
      |hasseEval r1 r2 c i1 i2 ((p1 : ℝ) / q1) ((p2 : ℝ) / q2)|

name: Erdos494.rlb_pow_clear
statement:
lemma rlb_pow_clear (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q) (m r : ℕ) (h : m ≤ r) :
    (q : ℝ) ^ r * ((p : ℝ) / q) ^ m = (p : ℝ) ^ m * (q : ℝ) ^ (r - m)

name: Erdos494.RL2.L1_monomial
statement:
lemma L1_monomial {R : Type*} [Ring R] {ν : R → ℝ} (hν : NormLike ν) (n : ℕ) (a : R) :
    L1 ν (monomial n a) = ν a

name: Erdos494.RL2.L1_normLike
statement: lemma L1_normLike {R : Type*} [Ring R] {ν : R → ℝ} (hν : NormLike ν) : NormLike (L1 ν)

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_HW_comb
statement:
lemma a2_HW_comb {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {m : ℕ} (f h : Fin m → R[X])
    (G : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin m) R) (hf : ∀ k', f k' = ∑ k, G k' k • h k) :
    a2_HW f = C G.det * a2_HW h

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_HW_map
statement:
lemma a2_HW_map {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → ℤ[X]) :
    a2_HW (fun k => (f k).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) = (a2_HW f).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_HW_ne_zero
statement: lemma a2_HW_ne_zero {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → ℚ[X]) (hf : LinearIndependent ℚ f) : a2_HW f ≠ 0

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_L1_hD_vecZ
statement:
lemma a2_L1_hD_vecZ (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n+1) → ℤ) (H : ℝ) (hH : ∀ i, |(v i : ℝ)| ≤ H) (μ : ℕ) :
    L1 (fun a : ℤ => (|a| : ℝ)) (hasseDeriv μ (a2_vecZ (n+1) v)) ≤ (n + 1) * 2 ^ n * H

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_L_apply
statement: lemma a2_L_apply (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → ℚ) : a2_L n v = ∑ i : Fin n, monomial (i : ℕ) (v i)

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_L_ker
statement: lemma a2_L_ker (n : ℕ) : LinearMap.ker (a2_L n) = ⊥

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_L_natDegree
statement:
lemma a2_L_natDegree (n : ℕ) (v : Fin (n+1) → ℚ) (k : ℕ) :
    (hasseDeriv k (a2_L (n+1) v)).natDegree < n + 1

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_S_big
statement:
lemma a2_S_big (r2 l : ℕ) (η : ℝ) (hr2 : 1 ≤ r2) (hl : 1 ≤ l) (hl2 : l ≤ r2 + 1) (hη : 0 < η)
    (hη4 : η ≤ 1/4) :
    2 * l * η < ∑ ν ∈ range l, max 0 (4 * Real.sqrt η - η - ν / r2)

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_basis
statement:
lemma a2_basis {n m : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin m) ℚ) : ∃ (l : ℕ) (I : Fin l → Fin n),
    LinearIndependent ℚ (fun k => M (I k)) ∧
    (∀ i, M i ∈ Submodule.span ℚ (Set.range fun k => M (I k))) ∧ l = M.transpose.rank

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_comp_expand
statement:
lemma a2_comp_expand (f : ℚ[X]) (x : ℚ) (r N : ℕ) (hN : f.natDegree < N) :
    f.comp (C x + X ^ r) = ∑ m ∈ range N, C ((hasseDeriv m f).eval x) * X ^ (r * m)

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_decomp
statement:
lemma a2_decomp (r1 r2 : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) : ∃ (l : ℕ) (I : Fin l → Fin (r1+1))
    (J : Fin l → Fin (r2+1)) (g : Fin (r1+1) → Fin l → ℚ),
    LinearIndependent ℚ (fun k => a2_L (r2+1) (fun j => (c (I k) j : ℚ))) ∧
    LinearIndependent ℚ (fun k => a2_L (r1+1) (fun i => (c i (J k) : ℚ))) ∧
    ∀ (i : Fin (r1+1)) (j : Fin (r2+1)), (c i j : ℚ) = ∑ k, g i k * c (I k) j

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_det_dvd
statement:
lemma a2_det_dvd {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {l : ℕ} (M : Matrix (Fin l) (Fin l) R[X])
    (d : Fin l → ℕ) (h : ∀ i j, X ^ d j ∣ M i j) : X ^ (∑ j, d j) ∣ M.det

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_det_ne_zero_of_injective
statement:
lemma a2_det_ne_zero_of_injective {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → Polynomial ℚ) (hne : ∀ k, f k ≠ 0)
    (hinj : Function.Injective fun k => (f k).natDegree) : (a2_wr f).det ≠ 0

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_entry_dvd
statement:
lemma a2_entry_dvd {l : ℕ} (φ ψ : Fin l → ℚ[X]) (x y : ℚ) (r1 r2 N1 N2 d μ ν : ℕ)
    (h1 : ∀ k, (hasseDeriv μ (φ k)).natDegree < N1)
    (h2 : ∀ k, (hasseDeriv ν (ψ k)).natDegree < N2)
    (hT : ∀ m n, r2 * m + r1 * n < d →
      ∑ k, (hasseDeriv (m + μ) (φ k)).eval x * (hasseDeriv (n + ν) (ψ k)).eval y = 0) :
    X ^ d ∣ ∑ k, (hasseDeriv μ (φ k)).comp (C x + X ^ r2) *
      (hasseDeriv ν (ψ k)).comp (C y + X ^ r1)

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_eval_hD_L
statement:
lemma a2_eval_hD_L (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → ℚ) (i : ℕ) (x : ℚ) :
    (hasseDeriv i (a2_L n v)).eval x = ∑ j : Fin n, ((j : ℕ).choose i : ℚ) * v j * x ^ ((j : ℕ) - i)

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_final
statement:
lemma a2_final (r1 r2 l e1 e2 : ℕ) (H η : ℝ) (q1 q2 : ℕ)
    (hr2 : 1 ≤ r2) (hl : 1 ≤ l) (hl2 : l ≤ r2 + 1) (hη : 0 < η) (hη4 : η ≤ 1/4)
    (hr21 : (r2:ℝ) ≤ η * r1) (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hq1 : 0 < q1)
    (hq12 : (q1:ℝ) ^ r1 ≤ (q2:ℝ) ^ r2) (hbig : 64 ^ r1 * H ≤ (q1:ℝ) ^ (η * r1))
    (hu1 : (q1:ℝ) ^ e1 ≤ (l.factorial : ℝ) * (((r1:ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ r1 * H) ^ l)
    (hu2 : (q2:ℝ) ^ e2 ≤ (l.factorial : ℝ) * (((r1:ℝ) + 1) * 2 ^ r1 * H) ^ l)
    (hlow : (r1:ℝ) * r2 * (∑ ν ∈ range l, max 0 (4 * Real.sqrt η - η - ν / r2)) ≤
      r2 * e1 + r1 * e2) : False

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_hE_zero
statement:
lemma a2_hE_zero (r1 r2 : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) (i1 i2 : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) (h : r1 < i1 ∨ r2 < i2) :
    hasseEval r1 r2 c i1 i2 x y = 0

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_hasseEval_eq
statement:
lemma a2_hasseEval_eq (r1 r2 : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) {l : ℕ} (I : Fin l → Fin (r1+1))
    (g : Fin (r1+1) → Fin l → ℚ)
    (hg : ∀ (i : Fin (r1+1)) (j : Fin (r2+1)), (c i j : ℚ) = ∑ k, g i k * c (I k) j)
    (i1 i2 : ℕ) (x y : ℚ) :
    hasseEval r1 r2 c i1 i2 (x : ℝ) (y : ℝ) =
     ((∑ k, (hasseDeriv i1 (a2_L (r1+1) (fun i => g i k))).eval x *
        (hasseDeriv i2 (a2_L (r2+1) (fun j => (c (I k) j : ℚ)))).eval y : ℚ) : ℝ)

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_iterate_derivative_add'
statement:
lemma a2_iterate_derivative_add' (p q : Polynomial ℚ) (k : ℕ) :
    derivative^[k] (p + q) = derivative^[k] p + derivative^[k] q

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_lower
statement:
lemma a2_lower {l : ℕ} (φ ψ : Fin l → ℚ[X]) (x y : ℚ) (r1 r2 N1 N2 : ℕ) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r1)
    (hr2 : 1 ≤ r2) (hU : a2_HW φ ≠ 0) (hV : a2_HW ψ ≠ 0) (d : Fin l → ℕ)
    (h1 : ∀ (μ : ℕ) k, (hasseDeriv μ (φ k)).natDegree < N1)
    (h2 : ∀ (ν : ℕ) k, (hasseDeriv ν (ψ k)).natDegree < N2)
    (hT : ∀ (μ ν : Fin l) (m n : ℕ), r2 * m + r1 * n < d ν →
      ∑ k, (hasseDeriv (m + μ) (φ k)).eval x * (hasseDeriv (n + ν) (ψ k)).eval y = 0) :
    ∑ ν, d ν ≤ r2 * rootMultiplicity x (a2_HW φ) + r1 * rootMultiplicity y (a2_HW ψ)

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_ord_le
statement:
lemma a2_ord_le (U V : ℚ[X]) (x y : ℚ) (r1 r2 D : ℕ) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r1) (hr2 : 1 ≤ r2)
    (hU : U ≠ 0) (hV : V ≠ 0)
    (h : X ^ D ∣ U.comp (C x + X ^ r2) * V.comp (C y + X ^ r1)) :
    D ≤ r2 * rootMultiplicity x U + r1 * rootMultiplicity y V

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_sum_id
statement: lemma a2_sum_id (n : ℕ) : (∑ ν ∈ range n, (ν : ℝ)) * 2 = n * (n - 1)

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_trivial
statement:
lemma a2_trivial (r1 r2 : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) (hc : BoxNonzero r1 r2 c) (x y : ℝ) :
    ∃ i1 ≤ r1, ∃ i2 ≤ r2, hasseEval r1 r2 c i1 i2 x y ≠ 0

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_vecZ_map
statement:
lemma a2_vecZ_map (n : ℕ) (v : Fin n → ℤ) :
    (a2_vecZ n v).map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) = a2_L n (fun i => (v i : ℚ))

name: Erdos494.RL2.a2_wmain
statement:
lemma a2_wmain {m : ℕ} (n : ℕ) : ∀ f : Fin m → Polynomial ℚ, (∑ k, (f k).natDegree) = n →
    LinearIndependent ℚ f → (a2_wr f).det ≠ 0

name: Erdos494.RL2.gauss_order_bound
statement:
theorem gauss_order_bound (U : Polynomial ℤ) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (hcop : IsCoprime p (q : ℤ)) (e : ℕ)
    (hdvd : (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C ((p : ℚ) / q)) ^ e ∣ U.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ)) :
    (q : ℤ) ^ e ∣ U.leadingCoeff

name: Erdos494.RL2.normLike_abs
statement: lemma normLike_abs : NormLike (fun a : ℤ => (|a| : ℝ))

name: Erdos494.RL2.normLike_prod
statement:
lemma normLike_prod {R : Type*} [CommRing R] {ν : R → ℝ} (hν : NormLike ν) {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → R) : ν (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, ν (g i)

name: Erdos494.RL2.normLike_sum
statement:
lemma normLike_sum {R : Type*} [Ring R] {ν : R → ℝ} (hν : NormLike ν) {ι : Type*}
    (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → R) : ν (∑ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, ν (g i)

name: Erdos494.RL2.wronskian_ne_zero
statement:
theorem wronskian_ne_zero {m : ℕ} (f : Fin m → Polynomial ℚ) (hf : LinearIndependent ℚ f) :
    (Matrix.of fun (μ k : Fin m) => Polynomial.derivative^[(μ : ℕ)] (f k)).det ≠ 0

name: Erdos494.hasseEval_abs_le
statement:
lemma hasseEval_abs_le (r1 r2 : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) (H : ℝ)
    (hH : ∀ k1 k2, |(c k1 k2 : ℝ)| ≤ H) (m1 m2 : ℕ) (θ : ℝ) :
    |hasseEval r1 r2 c m1 m2 θ θ| ≤
      ((r1 : ℝ) + 1) * ((r2 : ℝ) + 1) *
        ((|θ| + 1) ^ r1 * (|θ| + 1) ^ r2 * 2 ^ r1 * 2 ^ r2 * H)

name: Erdos494.hasseEval_eq_zero_left
statement:
lemma hasseEval_eq_zero_left (r1 r2 : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) (m1 m2 : ℕ) (h : r1 < m1) (x y : ℝ) :
    hasseEval r1 r2 c m1 m2 x y = 0

name: Erdos494.hasseEval_eq_zero_right
statement:
lemma hasseEval_eq_zero_right (r1 r2 : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) (m1 m2 : ℕ) (h : r2 < m2) (x y : ℝ) :
    hasseEval r1 r2 c m1 m2 x y = 0

name: Erdos494.hasseEval_taylor
statement:
lemma hasseEval_taylor (r1 r2 : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) (i1 i2 : ℕ) (θ u v : ℝ) :
    hasseEval r1 r2 c i1 i2 (θ + u) (θ + v) =
      ∑ j1 ∈ range (r1 - i1 + 1), ∑ j2 ∈ range (r2 - i2 + 1),
        ((i1 + j1).choose i1 : ℝ) * ((i2 + j2).choose i2 : ℝ) *
          hasseEval r1 r2 c (i1 + j1) (i2 + j2) θ θ * u ^ j1 * v ^ j2

name: Erdos494.taylor_uni
statement:
lemma taylor_uni (i k N : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ i + N) (θ u : ℝ) :
    (k.choose i : ℝ) * (θ + u) ^ (k - i) =
      ∑ j ∈ range (N + 1),
        ((i + j).choose i : ℝ) * (k.choose (i + j) : ℝ) * θ ^ (k - (i + j)) * u ^ j

name: Erdos494.taylor_upper_bound
statement:
theorem taylor_upper_bound (r1 r2 : ℕ) (hr1 : 1 ≤ r1) (hr2 : 1 ≤ r2) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℤ) (H : ℝ)
    (hH : ∀ k1 k2, |(c k1 k2 : ℝ)| ≤ H) (θ t Θ0 Λ : ℝ)
    (hvan : ∀ i1 i2 : ℕ, (i1 : ℝ) / r1 + (i2 : ℝ) / r2 < t → hasseEval r1 r2 c i1 i2 θ θ = 0)
    (i1 i2 : ℕ) (hi : (i1 : ℝ) / r1 + (i2 : ℝ) / r2 ≤ Θ0) (hΘ : Θ0 ≤ t)
    (hΛ0 : 0 < Λ) (hΛ1 : Λ ≤ 1) (x y : ℝ)
    (hx : |x - θ| ≤ Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / r1)) (hy : |y - θ| ≤ Λ ^ ((1 : ℝ) / r2)) :
    |hasseEval r1 r2 c i1 i2 x y| ≤
      ((r1 : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ((r2 : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * 8 ^ (r1 + r2) * H * (|θ| + 1) ^ (r1 + r2) *
        Λ ^ (t - Θ0)

name: Erdos494.DysonAux.box_finite
statement:
lemma box_finite (T : Set (ℤ × ℕ)) (B : ℝ)
    (h : ∀ v ∈ T, |(v.1 : ℝ)| ≤ B ∧ (v.2 : ℝ) ≤ B) : T.Finite

name: Erdos494.DysonAux.key_lt
statement:
lemma key_lt (r1 r2 q1 q2 : ℕ) (hq1R : (0 : ℝ) < q1) (hq2R : (0 : ℝ) < q2)
    (K θ κ t : ℝ) (hK1 : 1 ≤ K) (hR1pos : (0 : ℝ) < r1) (hR21 : (r2 : ℝ) ≤ r1)
    (hupper : (r2 : ℝ) * Real.log q2 ≤ 2 * (r1 * Real.log q1))
    (hκt : 9 / 2 ≤ κ * t)
    (hL1X : 8 + 4 * (Real.log 8 + Real.log K + Real.log (|θ| + 1)) < 3 * Real.log q1)
    (hL1 : 0 ≤ Real.log q1) :
    (q1 : ℝ) ^ r1 * (q2 : ℝ) ^ r2 *
      (((r1 : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * ((r2 : ℝ) + 1) ^ 2 * 8 ^ (r1 + r2) * K ^ (r1 + r2) *
        (|θ| + 1) ^ (r1 + r2) * ((q1 : ℝ) ^ (-(κ * r1))) ^ t) < 1

name: Erdos494.DysonAux.pow_eq_exp
statement: lemma pow_eq_exp (y : ℝ) (hy : 0 < y) (n : ℕ) : y ^ n = Real.exp (n * Real.log y)

name: Erdos494.DysonAux.sol_abs_le
statement:
lemma sol_abs_le (θ κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (p : ℤ) (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (h : |θ - (p : ℝ) / q| < (q : ℝ) ^ (-κ)) : |(p : ℝ)| ≤ (|θ| + 1) * q

name: Erdos494.ridout_decomp
statement:
lemma ridout_decomp (P r : ℕ) (hr : 0 < r) (x : ℕ) (hx : x ∈ Nat.smoothNumbers P) :
    ∃ a u : ℕ, 0 < a ∧ a ≤ ((P + 1) ^ r) ^ P ∧ 0 < u ∧ x = a * u ^ r

name: Erdos494.ridout_pow_sub_pow
statement:

name: Erdos494.TwoTermApprox.conversion
statement:
lemma conversion (s n κ i : ℕ) (hn : s < n) (hi1 : 1 ≤ i) (his : i + 1 ≤ s) (e : ℝ)
    (hclose : |Tf s n κ i - Tf s n κ (i + 1)| ≤ 2 * e * Tf s n κ (i + 1)) :
    |(n : ℝ) * (i : ℝ) ^ κ - ((s : ℝ) - i) * ((i : ℝ) + 1) ^ κ| ≤
      2 * e * (((s : ℝ) - i) * ((i : ℝ) + 1) ^ κ) + (s : ℝ) * (i : ℝ) ^ κ

name: Erdos494.TwoTermApprox.far
statement:
lemma far (T : ℕ → ℝ) (s m : ℕ) (μ : ℝ) (hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ) (hμ1 : μ ≤ 1)
    (hnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ T i) (hlc : ∀ k, T k * T (k + 2) ≤ μ * T (k + 1) ^ 2)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < T i ↔ (1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ s)) (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hms : m ≤ s)
    (hmax : ∀ i, T i ≤ T m) :
    ∀ i, (i + 2 ≤ m ∨ m + 2 ≤ i) → T i ≤ μ * T m

name: Erdos494.TwoTermApprox.far_up
statement:
lemma far_up (T : ℕ → ℝ) (s m : ℕ) (μ : ℝ) (hμ0 : 0 ≤ μ) (hμ1 : μ ≤ 1)
    (hnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ T i) (hlc : ∀ k, T k * T (k + 2) ≤ μ * T (k + 1) ^ 2)
    (hpos : ∀ i, 0 < T i ↔ (1 ≤ i ∧ i ≤ s)) (hm1 : 1 ≤ m) (hmax : ∀ i, T i ≤ T m) :
    ∀ d, T (m + d + 2) ≤ μ * T m

name: Erdos494.TwoTermApprox.final_step
statement:
lemma final_step (S q α θ I N : ℝ) (κ : ℕ) (hS1 : 1 < S) (hq1 : 1 < q) (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ)
    (hα0 : 0 < α) (hθq : θ * q ≤ α) (hακ : 4 * (S + 1) * q * α ^ κ ≤ 1) (hI1 : 1 ≤ I)
    (hIS : I + 1 ≤ S) (hiq : I * q ≤ α * (I + 1))
    (herr : |N - (S - I) * (I + 1) ^ κ| ≤
      2 * ((S + 1) * θ ^ κ) * ((S - I) * (I + 1) ^ κ) + S * I ^ κ) :
    |N - (S - I) * (I + 1) ^ κ| ≤ ((S - I) * (I + 1) ^ κ) ^ (1 - Real.logb S q)

name: Erdos494.two_term_approx
statement:
theorem two_term_approx (s : ℕ) (hs : 3 ≤ s) :
    ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ ∃ J0 : ℕ, ∀ n j : ℕ, s < n → J0 ≤ j → gfsPoly s n j = 0 →
      ∃ i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (s - 1),
        |((n * i ^ (j - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) - (((s - i) * (i + 1) ^ (j - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ)| ≤
          (((s - i) * (i + 1) ^ (j - 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (1 - δ) ∧
        n ≤ 2 * ((s - i) * (i + 1) ^ (j - 1))

    volume (Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) 1 ∩ (G ∩ X)) =

      pairStart A k i + depth A k ≤ pairStart A k j ∨
        pairStart A k j + depth A k ≤ pairStart A k i

name: Erdos996.Asm.pairStart_lt_of_lt
statement:
lemma pairStart_lt_of_lt (A k : ℕ) {s h s' h' : ℕ}
    (hs : s ∈ Finset.Ico (firstTrial A k) (firstTrial A (k + 1)))
    (hh : h ≤ blockLen A k + 1) (hss' : s < s') :
    pairStart A k ⟨s, h⟩ + depth A k ≤ pairStart A k ⟨s', h'⟩

name: Erdos996.Asm.real_count_aux
statement:
lemma real_count_aux (n L P Λ K : ℝ) (hcard : 7 * (Λ * K * 16777216) * L ≤ 8 * n)
    (hspec : P < 128 * 100 ^ 2 * L * Λ) (hK : 0 < K) (hL : 0 ≤ L) (hΛ : 0 ≤ Λ) :
    K * 2 ^ 3 * P ≤ n

name: Erdos996.Asm.stage_count_real
statement:
lemma stage_count_real (A k : ℕ) :
    (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 3) ≤ ((stagePairs A k).card : ℝ) * (2⁻¹ : ℝ) ^ depth A k

name: Erdos996.Asm.stage_of_mem_Ico
statement:
lemma stage_of_mem_Ico {A k s : ℕ} (hs : s ∈ Finset.Ico (firstTrial A k) (firstTrial A (k + 1))) :
    stage A s = k

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_eventually_small
statement:
lemma alt_eventually_small (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) :
    ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop, 32 ≤ N ∧
      (Real.log (Real.log (Real.log (N : ℝ))) ^ C) ^ 2 ≤ Real.sqrt N

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_lll_le_log
statement:
lemma alt_lll_le_log (N : ℕ) (hN : 32 ≤ N) :
    Real.log (Real.log (Real.log (N : ℝ))) ≤ Real.log (N : ℝ)

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_lll_lt
statement:
lemma alt_lll_lt (N e : ℕ) (hN : 32 ≤ N) (h : (N : ℝ) < (2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * e)) :
    Real.log (Real.log (Real.log (N : ℝ))) <
      Real.log (Real.log (Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * e))))

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_lll_pos
statement: lemma alt_lll_pos (N : ℕ) (hN : 32 ≤ N) : 0 < Real.log (Real.log (Real.log (N : ℝ)))

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_log_gt_three
statement: lemma alt_log_gt_three (N : ℕ) (hN : 32 ≤ N) : 3 < Real.log (N : ℝ)

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_one_lt_loglog
statement: lemma alt_one_lt_loglog (N : ℕ) (hN : 32 ≤ N) : 1 < Real.log (Real.log (N : ℝ))

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_summable_weight
statement:
lemma alt_summable_weight (A : ℕ) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (C : ℝ) (_hC : 0 < C) :
    Summable (fun k : ℕ => lam A k * ((((A : ℝ) + 1) * (k + 1) + 30) ^ C) ^ 2)

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_term_bound
statement:
lemma alt_term_bound (A : ℕ) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) (e k : ℕ)
    (hE : Real.log (Real.log (Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * e)))) ≤ ((A : ℝ) + 1) * (k + 1) + 30)
    (N : ℕ) (hN : 32 ≤ N) :
    lam A k * min 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ e / N) ≤
      lam A k / Real.sqrt N + lam A k * ((((A : ℝ) + 1) * (k + 1) + 30) ^ C) ^ 2 /
        (Real.log (Real.log (Real.log (N : ℝ))) ^ C) ^ 2

name: Erdos996.Asm.tail_asymp
statement:
lemma tail_asymp (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 < C) : ∃ A₀ : ℕ, ∀ A : ℕ, A₀ ≤ A → ∀ E : ℕ → ℕ,
    (∀ k, Real.log (Real.log (Real.log ((2 : ℝ) ^ (2 * E k)))) ≤ ((A : ℝ) + 1) * (k + 1) + 30) →
    ∀ C₁ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ → ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      Real.sqrt (C₁ * ∑' k, lam A k * min 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ E k / N)) ≤
        K * (1 / (Real.log (Real.log (Real.log N))) ^ C)

name: Erdos996.SpikeTailAux.fc_dilate
statement:
lemma fc_dilate (d Q : ℕ) (hQ : 0 < Q) (s : ℤ) :
    fourierCoeff (fun x : 𝕋 => (spike d (Q • x) : ℂ)) ((Q : ℤ) * s) =
      fourierCoeff (fun x : 𝕋 => (spike d x : ℂ)) s

name: Erdos996.SpikeTailAux.fc_eq_zero_of_not_dvd
statement:
lemma fc_eq_zero_of_not_dvd (d Q : ℕ) (hQ : 0 < Q) (r : ℤ) (h : ¬ (Q : ℤ) ∣ r) :
    fourierCoeff (fun x : 𝕋 => (spike d (Q • x) : ℂ)) r = 0

name: Erdos996.SpikeTailAux.fc_spike
statement:
lemma fc_spike (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (s : ℤ) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    fourierCoeff (fun x : 𝕋 => (spike d x : ℂ)) s =
      (((Real.sqrt ((2:ℝ)⁻¹ ^ d * (1 - (2:ℝ)⁻¹ ^ d)))⁻¹ : ℝ) : ℂ) *
        ((Complex.exp (-(2 * π * Complex.I * s) * (((2:ℝ)⁻¹ ^ d : ℝ) : ℂ)) - 1) /
          -(2 * π * Complex.I * s))

name: Erdos996.SpikeTailAux.fourier_add_arg
statement: lemma fourier_add_arg (n : ℤ) (x y : 𝕋) : fourier n (x + y) = fourier n x * fourier n y

name: Erdos996.SpikeTailAux.measurable_spike
statement: lemma measurable_spike (d : ℕ) : Measurable (spike d)

name: Erdos996.SpikeTailAux.mem_spikeSet_iff
statement:
lemma mem_spikeSet_iff (d : ℕ) (z : 𝕋) :
    z ∈ (QuotientAddGroup.mk '' Set.Ico (0 : ℝ) ((2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ d) : Set 𝕋) ↔
      ((AddCircle.equivIco 1 0 z : ℝ)) < (2 : ℝ)⁻¹ ^ d

name: Erdos996.SpikeTailAux.norm_fc_spike_sq_le
statement:
lemma norm_fc_spike_sq_le (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (s : ℤ) (hs : s ≠ 0) :
    ‖fourierCoeff (fun x : 𝕋 => (spike d x : ℂ)) s‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (2:ℝ)⁻¹ ^ d ∧
    ‖fourierCoeff (fun x : 𝕋 => (spike d x : ℂ)) s‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 / ((2:ℝ)⁻¹ ^ d * (s:ℝ) ^ 2)

name: Erdos996.SpikeTailAux.tail_int
statement:
lemma tail_int (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) :
    Summable (fun s : ℤ => if K < |(s:ℝ)| then 1 / (s:ℝ) ^ 2 else 0) ∧
    ∑' s : ℤ, (if K < |(s:ℝ)| then 1 / (s:ℝ) ^ 2 else 0) ≤ 4 / K

name: Erdos996.SpikeTailAux.tail_nat
statement:
lemma tail_nat (K : ℝ) (hK : 0 < K) (L : ℕ) :
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range L, (if K < (n:ℝ) then 1 / (n:ℝ) ^ 2 else 0) ≤ 2 / K

name: Erdos996.spike_dilate_tail
statement:
lemma spike_dilate_tail :
    ∃ C₁ : ℝ, 0 < C₁ ∧ ∀ (d v N : ℕ), 1 ≤ d → 1 ≤ N →
      ∑' r : {r : ℤ // (N : ℤ) < |r|},
          ‖fourierCoeff (fun x : 𝕋 => (spike d ((2 ^ v : ℕ) • x) : ℂ)) r‖ ^ 2
        ≤ C₁ * min 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ (d + v) / N)

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_fc_blk_disj
statement:
lemma alt_fc_blk_disj (A k k' : ℕ) (r : ℤ) (hne : k ≠ k') :
    fourierCoeff (fun x => (blk A k x : ℂ)) r = 0 ∨
      fourierCoeff (fun x => (blk A k' x : ℂ)) r = 0

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_hasSum_norm_sq
statement:
lemma alt_hasSum_norm_sq (A : ℕ) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (r : ℤ) :
    HasSum (fun k => ‖fourierCoeff (fun x => (blk A k x : ℂ)) r‖ ^ 2)
      (‖fourierCoeff (fun x => (gFun A x : ℂ)) r‖ ^ 2)

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_norm_blk_sq
statement:
lemma alt_norm_blk_sq (A k : ℕ) (r : ℤ) :
    ‖fourierCoeff (fun x => (blk A k x : ℂ)) r‖ ^ 2 =
      lam A k / blockLen A k *
        ∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (blockLen A k), ‖fourierCoeff (fun x => (atom A k q x : ℂ)) r‖ ^ 2

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_norm_sum_sq_of_disj
statement:
lemma alt_norm_sum_sq_of_disj {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (f : ι → ℂ)
    (h : ∀ i ∈ s, ∀ j ∈ s, i ≠ j → f i = 0 ∨ f j = 0) :
    ‖∑ i ∈ s, f i‖ ^ 2 = ∑ i ∈ s, ‖f i‖ ^ 2

name: Erdos996.Asm.alt_summable_atom
statement:
lemma alt_summable_atom (A k q : ℕ) :
    Summable (fun r : ℤ => ‖fourierCoeff (fun x => (atom A k q x : ℂ)) r‖ ^ 2)

name: Erdos996.Asm.tail_sum_le
statement:
lemma tail_sum_le : ∃ C₁ : ℝ, 0 < C₁ ∧ ∀ A : ℕ, 1 ≤ A → ∀ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N →
    ∑' r : {r : ℤ // (N : ℤ) < |r|}, ‖fourierCoeff (fun x => (gFun A x : ℂ)) r‖ ^ 2 ≤
      C₁ * ∑' k, lam A k * min 1 ((2 : ℝ) ^ logQ A k / N)

name: Erdos996.spike_ge
statement:
lemma spike_ge (d : ℕ) (hd : 1 ≤ d) (x : 𝕋) :
    -(1 / Real.sqrt (2 ^ d - 1)) ≤ spike d x

name: Erdos996.not_lacunaryAveragesConverge
statement:
theorem not_lacunaryAveragesConverge {f : Lp ℂ 2 μ𝕋} {n : ℕ → ℕ} {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hint : ∫ t, f t ∂μ𝕋 = 0)
    (hpos : 0 < μ𝕋 {x | ∃ᶠ N in atTop, δ ≤ ‖(∑ k ∈ range N, f (n k • x)) / (N : ℂ)‖}) :
    ¬ LacunaryAveragesConverge f n
